sloka: विवर्ण वदनाः सर्वे सर्वे ध्यान परायणाः ।न अधिगच्छामहे पारम् मग्नाः चिन्ता महाअर्णवे ॥४-५२-१०॥
transliteration: vivarṇa vadanāḥ sarve sarve dhyāna parāyaṇāḥ ।na adhigacchāmahe pāram magnāḥ cintā mahāarṇave ॥4-52-10॥

translations.english: 'We were all exhausted, lost in thought and worried, unable to cross this deep ocean of sorrow. We did not know how to proceed.
